S11 is F1a (note_line: the text-node index, as for S9/S10); round 9: n1v5_chain (the chain that mapped the row, or 'carried' for a v0.4 row carried unchanged in key), v0_4_row (the v0.4 row a chain's row restates, span#seq in results/raw/2026-10-09_note-N1-v0_4-note-rows.json@fd2b136), round9 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}: a chain's change against that v0.4 row, or an integration edit; a previous of null: the field was absent), n1v5_round2 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}: a D8 row's change between the chain's round 1 and round 2), scope_corrected_in_note ({locator, quote, note_quote}: the PI's ruling 6 of 2026-10-10, on a branch-TS row; for an SVG row the note_quote may run from the row's node through the next nodes, newline-joined as note_text joins them), discharged ({ruling, note_quote}: ruling 7, on a branch-NT row), admitted_citation ({ruling, cited_source, note_quote}: ruling 8, on a not-found note row); round 10: n1v6_chain (the chain that mapped the row, G1-G3, or 'carried' for a v0.5 row carried unchanged in key), v0_5_row (the v0.5 row a chain's row restates, span#seq in results/raw/2026-10-10_note-N1-v0_5-note-rows.json@fa1b41e), round10 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}: a chain's change against that v0.5 row, or an integration edit; on a chain's record, the integration's entries follow the chain's own, one per field it changes: S1#428's four, and S5#106's comment, fix round 3), n1v6_round2 ({finding, why, changed: [{field, previous}]}: a G3 row's change between the chain's round 1 and round 2), admitted_citation's 'reach' (the PI's ruling 11 of 2026-10-12, on an occurrence of an admitted citation at a (line, unit) ruling 8 does not name;
